events.text: Germany invades Poland, beginning the Second World War in Europe.
The Great Kantō earthquake devastates Tokyo and Yokohama.
Muammar Gaddafi seizes power in Libya in a military coup.
Korean Air Lines Flight 007 is shot down by a Soviet interceptor.
The wreck of the Titanic is located by a Franco-American expedition.
